definitions.full: H4659. miph 'al [ מִפְעָל ] noun [masculine] work, thing made (by ׳י ); — plural suffix מִפְעָלָיו Prov 8:22 . [ מִפְעָלָה ] noun [feminine] deed (of ׳י ); — plural construct י ׳מִפְעֲלוֺת Psa 46:9 , ׳מ אֱלֹהִים 66:5 .
